532:t_2:119.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... It seems this is the only way...)

532:t_2:132.en:
$$桂$$
「You and me...! Even both $$特異点$$s together aren't enough?!」

532:t_2:133.en:
$$オルソン$$
「At this rate... space-time will collapse...!」

532:t_2:134.en:
$$桂$$
「Daaaaamn it!! What's the point of being a $$特異点$$?!」

532:t_2:145.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$ロロ$$! $$シャーリー$$!」

532:t_2:148.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So you... won't forgive me after all...」

532:t_2:152.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Regret... Repentance... Despair... Death... Is this the future the $$集合無意識$$ shows us...?」

532:t_2:155.en:
$$シャルル$$
「It has been a long time, $$ルルーシュ$$.」

532:t_2:156.en:
$$マリアンヌ$$
「You look well, $$ルルーシュ$$.」

532:t_2:157.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$! And $$マリアンヌ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$ too!」

532:t_2:158.en:
$$シャルル$$
「Your comrades are now trapped in a world beyond time and space, shown by the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:159.en:
$$マリアンヌ$$
「It is the shape of the future, the image of despair you yourself sensed.」

532:t_2:160.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So we are heading toward a future of despair?!」

532:t_2:163.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「How could I possibly rely on the likes of you?!」

532:t_2:164.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Whatever that future of despair may be, I... We will overcome it!」

532:t_2:165.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「And we will resist, whatever we face! Even if it is God!」

532:t_2:166.en:
$$マリアンヌ$$
「Hehe... Can you really do it?」

532:t_2:167.en:
$$シャルル$$
「Show me, $$ルルーシュ$$! Show me how you live, having rejected $$マリアンヌ$$ and me and chosen the future!」

532:t_2:168.en:
$$シャルル$$
「And only when you overcome despair will I acknowledge that you have truly surpassed me!」

532:t_2:172.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ルルーシュ$$...! $$ルルーシュ$$!」

532:t_2:174.en:
$$スザク$$
「We're in front of the ruins' door.」

532:t_2:175.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I know that, but why is $$熱気バサラ$$ singing?」

532:t_2:176.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's what I'd like to know.」

532:t_2:177.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Apparently, $$バサラ$$ was singing alone while we went through hell.」

532:t_2:178.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「He alone wasn't swallowed by that $$時空震動$$-like phenomenon...」

532:t_2:179.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Even you don't seem to know why.」

532:t_2:180.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I suppose we can only attribute it to the power of his songs...」

532:t_2:181.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Come on, $$バサラ$$! Read the room already and stop!」

532:t_2:182.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What are you talking about?! I'm just getting started!」

532:t_2:183.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is this the time for that?! $$クロウ$$ hasn't come back!」

532:t_2:184.en:
$n
「It's possible he was transported outside the ruins.」

532:t_2:185.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$ might be nearby. Let's find $$クロウ$$.」

532:t_2:186.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Come on, you too, $$バサラ$$!」

532:t_2:188.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! I'll leave $$ルルーシュ$$ to you!」

532:t_2:190.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Those eyes... It seems you met $$シャルル$$ and $$マリアンヌ$$ too.」

532:t_2:191.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I never imagined they... were alive inside the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:192.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Who knows? They may have been the $$シャルル$$ and $$マリアンヌ$$ within you and me, shown by the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:194.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But in my own way, I learned what $$シャルル$$ was trying to do.」

532:t_2:195.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As a successor to the Code, he too knew the future of despair. He tried to return to the $$集合無意識$$ to avoid it...」

532:t_2:196.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「He stopped time to deny any advance toward the future.」

532:t_2:197.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That was probably his own $$時の牢獄$$.」

532:t_2:198.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I... reject him. That feeling still hasn't changed.」

532:t_2:201.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Yes, $$ルルーシュ$$. That is the responsibility you bear.」

532:t_2:202.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...Very well. If that man could do it, there's no reason I can't!」

532:t_2:203.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I won't run away as he did...! I will face despair and find a way to overcome it!」

532:t_2:210.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I can't read his movements before he attacks at all. I have to see it and react...!」

532:t_2:212.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're empty even now? It's better than enjoying murder, but it's still unbearable.」

532:t_2:213.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Sending lives on is our vocation.」

532:t_2:215.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The $$鬼宿$$ govern the guiding of the power born when lives end in the proper direction...」

532:t_2:216.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You mean the power of life, and the power when it ends...」

532:t_2:217.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You mean the force that seeks to exist, and the force that seeks to vanish.」

532:t_2:218.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is correct. The $$沈黙の巨蟹$$'s $$スフィア$$ resonates with my power as a $$鬼宿$$.」

532:t_2:219.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Death is losing one's body... Nothing can replace that sense of loss... It is the deepest void.」
